worktree_hint: The code-progress ledger: which checkout is moving, what branch it carries, who is driving it, and what changed this round. Cards track decisions; worktrees track code, and neither is inferred from the other.
worktree_empty: No worktrees registered yet. Run `multica worktree add <name>` after cutting a branch, or use New.

agentwiki.no_cases: No cases yet. Distill one via interview-retro's Case rule after solving a meaty problem.

worktree_add_hint: Branch heads and merge SHAs are measured by `multica worktree sync` inside the checkout, not typed here — a merge claim nobody can re-check is worth nothing.
session_empty: Unclaimed. Click to set who is driving, the resume pointer, and what is next.
entry_placeholder: What changed this round, in one line
entries_empty: Nothing logged yet. Write a line when a round ends; a commit is not required.
declarations_hint: These cards declare git.* keys but belong to no tree yet. Attach one with: multica issue metadata set <card> git.worktree <tree>.
